Picking the best from such a diverse pool of players is really hard when you ultimately can only pick 1. I thought Nicholas put in an absolute beast of a performance in goal. Leonardo and Jimmy both performed. While Leo shows amazing spirit I would still give the heads up to Jimmy for his coolnes on the ball and his ability to pull out some amazing long shot goals. Sam, while not the most flashy has been the most clinical striker out of the bunch throughout the series. Pedro had the single most amazing assist in the previous episode but I think he underperformed this time. Liam shows great potential and can move the ball up the pitch like no one else, but I do think he is a bit too greedy in his plays. If he would pass the ball after going past a couple I think it would serve the team better. He also seems to be quite negative if his team isnt winning. I think Jairo was overall one of the best players throughout all 3 tryouts so far. While not as flashy as some of the others mans a baller. Finally my heart breaks for Tanel who I think was the clear best attacker of the bunch. If it wasnt for the injury he would be my pick for an attacker. Jimmy for defender and again, Nicholas showed class as goalkeeper. Great videos guys!
